item.title: Products, Parts, Processes, and Poetry #1: Hydraulic Cartridge Valves
item.description: Cartridge valves are products That many people don’t know, But without their range of functions How would we control oil flow? In fact, flow is just one thing That these valves can shape and change. They also provide direction Or influence pressure range. Check valves might be the simplest.

item.title: Products, Parts, Processes, and Poetry #2: Linear Actuators and Cylinders
item.description: A linear actuator Gives motion in a straight path, So stay out of its way Unless you want to feel its wrath. There are many varieties, You’ll find them everywhere, They can work with hydraulics, Electricity, or air. You might use an electric To push something quick but light.
